reuse.why: Reuses linkSimpleFinAccount, downloadAkahuTransactions and findOrCreateBank for Fintegra, but by bending them (a provider flag that overwrites the sync source after insert, server/provider overrides on an Akahu-named function) and the guard wrapper ignores its own assertAccountNotLinked helper.

duplication.why: withBankAccountGuard re-implements assertAccountNotLinked's check and error inline, and copies unlinkAccount's account-field reset block (account_id, bank, balances, sync source, status) instead of sharing it.

placement.why: Lookup and closed-account checks sit in link.ts, but the guard/takeover logic is a wrapper in app.ts registration, and the new provider is added as an ad-hoc union in AccountSyncSource rather than in the SYNC_PROVIDERS list that defines providers.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (single link, Fintegra, closed accounts, takeover); no unrelated changes beyond widening the DbAccount sync-source type.

maintainability.why: Fintegra is a SimpleFin link that writes 'simpleFin' then patches it to 'fintegra', and syncs through downloadAkahuTransactions with overridden server and label, so a change to either provider silently affects Fintegra; the unlink field list now lives in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts withBankAccountGuard clears the link with a hand-written db.updateAccount instead of the unlink logic and repeats assertAccountNotLinked inline; types/models/account.ts adds 'fintegra' outside SYNC_PROVIDERS in bank-sync.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink field reset in withBankAccountGuard is a reshaped copy of unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount block, and the already-linked check is re-expressed via findLinkedAccount plus an inline throw duplicating assertAccountNotLinked.

abstraction_drift.where: linkSimpleFinAccount gains a provider parameter with an if (provider === 'fintegra') overwrite branch; downloadAkahuTransactions gains server and provider parameters; LinkAccountBaseParams gains replaceExistingLink; withBankAccountGuard bypasses assertAccountNotLinked and unlinkAccount.
